name: Lincsolution Co. Ltd.
summary: Established in 2015 and headquartered in Anyang-si, South Korea, Lincsolution is a specialist in the creation and production of desktop 3D printing technology for commercial applications. Their extensive product portfolio includes the economical LINK EP-300 and LINK EP-500, both designed for crafting items from engineering plastics, with the latter accommodating larger build volumes. For industrial-scale production, they offer SLD 3D printers like the LINK SL-1600, equipped with a dual-laser system, and the high-capacity LINK SL-2300. Additionally, Lincsolution provides specialized printers such as the MonoPure Bio, capable of processing diverse biomaterial viscosities including semi-solids, and the MonoPure Food, tailored for printing with high-viscosity food materials. Complementing their hardware, the company delivers comprehensive additive manufacturing services, spanning from production and engineering device design, 3D scanning and reverse engineering, to DfAM for inspection and weight optimization, mold design, prototype development, and full-scale commercialization.
